## Findings
- claim-1: Inspected formal source: `sources/0809.2981v2.tex`, revision `source-revision-9f2d90286b159738da58b0fe0bd47f85b5597dcdbd2b987cea65817b43536281`. It states: “The \(\ZZ\)-basis for \(\Lambda\) given by the Schur functions \(s_\lambda\)” and that \(I_{r,n-r}\), “spanned by all \(s_\lambda\) with \(\lambda\not\subseteq(n-r)^r\), forms an ideal”; it further identifies the in-box classes \(\{s_\lambda:\lambda\subseteq(n-r)^r\}\) as a \(\ZZ\)-basis. [source-2@L1312-L1330|claim=formal-document]
- claim-2: Therefore \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) is a free abelian group with basis \(\{\bar s_\lambda:\lambda\subseteq(n-r)^r\}\): quotient the direct Schur decomposition of \(\Lambda\) by the direct summand spanned by the out-of-box Schur functions. The source’s ideal statement makes this a quotient-ring basis. [source-2@L1318-L1324|claim=formal-document]
- claim-3: The supplied formal excerpts contain no Littlewood–Richardson or Pieri multiplication formula in the quotient, such as \(\bar s_\lambda\bar s_\mu=\sum_{\nu\subseteq(n-r)^r}c_{\lambda\mu}^{\nu}\bar s_\nu\) or the horizontal-strip specialization for \(h_k\bar s_\lambda\). The cited generating-family passage only states ideal generation. [source-2@L1312-L1330|claim=formal-document] [source-2@L1363-L1375|claim=formal-document] [source-2@L1384-L1400|claim=formal-document]
- claim-4: The requested combined source certificate is **not established** from the supplied source record: its integral in-box Schur-basis portion is established, but its quotient LR/Pieri-multiplication portion lacks a stable formal-source excerpt.
## Strategy
Inspect `sources/0809.2981v2.tex`, revision `source-revision-9f2d90286b159738da58b0fe0bd47f85b5597dcdbd2b987cea65817b43536281`. Its bounded formal excerpt `source-2@L1312-L1330` establishes the integral in-box Schur basis. The supplied formal excerpts at `source-2@L1363-L1375` and `source-2@L1384-L1400` were checked for quotient multiplication statements.

## Gaps
No supplied stable formal-source excerpt states the box-truncated Littlewood–Richardson formula or its Pieri specialization, including the out-of-box-vanishing convention. Thus the requested combined source certificate is **not established**: only its integral-basis portion is source-grounded.

## Next
Provide a formal-source excerpt with stable locators explicitly stating the quotient LR and Pieri formulas for \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\).
